parameters.notes: Instinct Synergy. Each listed control was wheeled to both ends in the vendor panel and moved only its own float32 value; min/max are the raw limits seen. Raw units: no physical unit is claimed. Switches and selectors were clicked instead (2026-11-21); each changed only its own byte and min/max are the values seen; names and value meanings were read from the per-state pictures. The block is 26 four-byte values, little-endian float32 for the knobs. The wheel kept turning for seconds after each value stopped at its limit, so min/max are where the panel clamps. Centre Knob is the large unlabelled knob in the middle of the panel. The four switches are the first byte of their value (0 or 1 seen): Model is the slider under the centre (0 transistor, 1 tube), Drive Circuit and Post Filter the small round buttons at the Filter and PF groups, Morph Alt the ALT button; the names are the ones the status bar of the panel shows. The value at offset 44 (1.0) never changed; the round button at the top left was outside the probed area. Unmapped bytes are written back unchanged. Read layout on this device: loaded alone into an empty rack through this project's server, the cat 0x07 reply was one flag byte then the block and nothing else (one instance per reply)
